requirements: Stage only the declared runtime payload and independent local viewer before promotion.
Install routing, prompts, scenarios, schemas, policies, templates, integrations, project configuration, and local guidance synchronization under .mission-directives.
Keep repository development, validation, evaluation, import, CI, tests, and the Astro documentation site in the source repository.
Fail closed when .mission-directives exists unless upgrade is explicit.
Preserve output categories and project configuration during upgrade.
Preserve all unmanaged AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .gitignore content.
Restore the prior installation and project files if post-promotion synchronization fails.
Treat Project Config as durable context, never as authorization or a secret store.
Write receipts, locks, backups, and viewer state only under .mission-directives/state.
